children: shares continued gains for seven straight sessions, as the stock closed 2.3% higher at $279.11 on Tuesday.
The company gained over 5% in the preceding six sessions. Overall, the stock has risen over 140% so far this year, compared to the nearly 14% rise in the broader S&P 500 Index.
CRWD is up nearly 34% over the past one month. The stock closed 0.9% high on Monday at $272.67.
Looking at Seeking Alpha's Quant Rating, CRWD has a
with a score of 3.49 out of 5. The company received an A+ in the prospect of momentum, while it got an F in the valuation factor.
community, 40 analysts gave CRWD a Buy or above, 12 analysts have given the stock a Hold recommendation, and one recommended Sell. Seeking Alpha analysts are also
and see the stock as a Hold.
A recent Seeking Alpha analysis from The Techie noted that the stock is not cheap, especially against the cybersecurity peer group.
“Still, this is no reason to turn bearish, as I expect the market will continue to overlook the multiples in favor of the future growth potential,” it added.
However, others have a slightly different view. Seeking Alpha analyst Oliver Rodzianko sees the stock as a Hold, citing “extreme valuation.”

“CrowdStrike is well-positioned as a company; I admit that, but this valuation is extreme, and allocating capital to the business at this equity price is unwise in my opinion. I find it valid that the bull case could materialize, but I view it as unlikely, maybe a 10-20% chance of materializing versus an 80% chance of a neutral consolidation or moderate decline. As a result, the only logical rating based on my analysis is Hold,” said Rodzianko.
